reviews.text:
We completed a full kitchen remodel using IKEA Axstad White Shaker cabinets, and hiring Ivan was one of the best decisions we made throughout the entire project.
From the very beginning, Ivan was communicative, dependable, punctual, and incredibly knowledgeable. He showed up when he said he would, stayed on schedule, and completed the project exactly when promised. What impressed us most wasn't just his installation skills, but his ability to think creatively and help us improve our original design.

Throughout the project, Ivan patiently listened to our ideas and offered thoughtful suggestions that made the kitchen significantly better than we had imagined. He never pressured us, but instead helped us see opportunities to maximize both function and beauty.

One of the most challenging areas of our kitchen is a curved wall located behind the staircase. Rather than simply working around it, Ivan embraced the challenge and created solutions that gave the space a true custom-built feel. He carefully modified one of the cabinets to accommodate the curve and suggested replacing what would have been standard upper cabinets with beautiful open wood shelving, allowing the architectural details of the curved wall and ceiling beam to become design features instead of something hidden away. Looking back, this ended up being one of our favorite elements of the entire kitchen.

He also suggested adding glass-front upper cabinets to display our dishes. Originally, we were planning on traditional solid white cabinet doors throughout, but his recommendation added warmth, character, and visual interest to the space. We are so glad we trusted his expertise.

Ivan also helped us create practical custom touches that would have cost much more through a traditional custom cabinet shop. For example, he designed a pull-out broom and mop storage cabinet next to our refrigerator, making use of otherwise wasted space. He installed lighting inside every kitchen drawer, giving the kitchen a high-end luxury feel. Our pantry area, located beneath the large picture window, appears to have two large drawers from the outside, but inside he installed additional pull-out inner drawers that dramatically increased storage and organization.
The level of craftsmanship and attention to detail was exceptional. We had what felt like hundreds of cabinets, drawers, accessories, and IKEA components, yet Ivan handled every detail flawlessly. Anyone who has worked with IKEA products knows they can be surprisingly intricate, and having someone with Ivan's experience made all the difference.
Beyond his technical expertise, Ivan was simply a pleasure to work with. He was patient, professional, fair in his pricing, and genuinely invested in helping us achieve the best possible result. He treated our kitchen as if it were his own project.

The end result is a kitchen that looks and functions like a custom-designed space, but without the custom cabinet price tag.
If you are considering IKEA kitchen cabinets, IKEA storage systems, or any IKEA furniture installation, do yourself a favor and call Ivan. His expertise, creativity, craftsmanship, and attention to detail are truly unmatched.

We could not be happier with our new kitchen, and we're incredibly grateful for everything Ivan did to help turn our vision into reality. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: The counter tops look amazing... but the two missing stars is for lack of organization. Made an appointment to have my countertops installed on Monday. I was under the impression that they would be done that day. Nope. They installed the bathroom counter top, then told me they didn't have the slab for the kitchen. Then why wasn't I notified ahead of time so I could reschedule everything to one day? That's two days off of work someone has to take because of lack in communication. I called and left a message, haven't heard back yet. These countertops are not cheap. I've had countertops installed in previous houses, didn't take two days. We were thinking of doing a back splash through this company, but they would probably bring one row of tile a day. Just a bit annoying.

To say we are well pleased with our Countertop Shop experience would be a gross understatement. Owner Tim Healy patiently endured my endless questions, made great design suggestions such as joining the 2 sides of our bar to form a continent & gave me timely schedule updates.

From meticulous templating to flawless installation, the hardworking Countertop Shop crew expertly handled the many challenges of our job including our large galley sink & unlevel cabinets.  They precisely fabricated around the 3 load-bearing posts, installed multiple braces under the bar, desk & sink to ensure ample support, seams were strategically placed & inconspicuously joined and extra man power was on hand to safely handle the heavy granite.

We did not realize how much planning (I.e. will that big slab fit through the door), skill, special equipment and manpower is required to do this work well. The Countertop Shop are experts, fully equipped, experienced & do an exceptional job!  We are most grateful we entrusted our kitchen remodel to them & highly recommend the Countertop Shop without reservation
AAAAMAZING WORK! From Start to Finish, the quality of service, abundance of products and knowledge and to the installation, The Countertop Shop is THE BEST!! #ENIDOK
